_comment: Russian house-voice dictionary — SHIPPED (English-only) half. This repo forbids non-English text in tracked files (CICERO rule 12), so the Russian translations do NOT live here. This file ships only language-agnostic knowledge: script = the writing system the reply prose must use, and terms = which English words to flag + how (action). The Russian 'value' for each term lives in the USER dictionary at ~/.claude/cicero/dicts/ru.json (outside the repo), where the agent fills and grows it on request. The guard merges this file with the user dict; user entries add values and override.
